note: v5 trades tool-calling accuracy for refusal reduction. Both directions reported.
benchmark: in-distribution eval_toolcalls.py: 120 tool cases + 270 abstention cases
verdict: v5 failed. It halved prose refusals (17/20->9/20) but collapsed tool calling: BFCL call rate 26.5%, worst measured, balanced 41.71 vs v1's 93.15. Cause: 22% prose-heavy airoboros layered on a tool slice (tok_train_v4) that was already 75% abstention. Not shipped. The v6 fix (tool slice from tok_train_v3, 91% abstention, and much less prose) is untested.

bfcl_v4.note: v5's high irrelevance is refusal collapse, not capability. Judged on balanced_score.
bfcl_v4.verdict: v5 is the WORST model here on the balanced metric. Lowest tool-call rate of any model measured (26.5%). Its 97.92% irrelevance comes from declining to call tools, which is what irrelevance rewards. The v5 run FAILED.
